description: The true path of The Last Ferry told from its data (the same moves): the cup was last seen after the suspect had left, and he could not come back; the order of events clears him, and the keys leave one man.

moves.see: the christening cup was at the vestry
moves.why: Tam Reed saw the cup on its shelf as he lit the lamp.

moves.pick: after the gate lamp was lit
moves.why: So it was taken after the lamp was lit.

moves.pick: before the gate lamp was lit
moves.why: It cannot have gone before: it was still there.

moves.see: the christening cup was at the vestry
moves.why: Whoever took it took it after the lamp was lit.

moves.see: Silas Bell was at the ferry
moves.why: The ferry cast off before the lamp was lit, with Bell aboard: Hobb saw it kindled behind them.
And the only boat lay at the far bank all night.
Bell left before the cup was last seen, and had no way back.
The vestry was locked when the lamp was lit.
And at nine the lock had not been forced: it was opened with a key.

moves.see: [Nn]obody but Josiah Crane and Amos Dunn
moves.why: There are two keys, and mine was in my pocket.
The other key is the sexton's.
